Metadata.title: Better Content
Metadata.description: A focused foundation for your creator workspace.

HomePage.title: Start with the interface language that feels natural to you.
HomePage.description: Better Content is being prepared as a focused workspace for creators.
HomePage.languageNote: It changes the application UI, not the language of the content you create.

Auth.signUpDescription: Create a secure account to begin using Better Content.
Auth.signInDescription: Sign in to continue to your creator workspace.
Auth.password: Use a password between 8 and 128 characters.
Auth.accountExists: An account already exists for this email address.
Auth.invalidCredentials: The email address or password is incorrect.
Auth.generic: We could not complete that request. Please try again.

Content.title: Content workspace
Content.description: Open a Script Draft and keep the work you are shaping in one place.
Content.emptyDescription: Generated Content Drafts will appear here when they are ready to edit.
Content.editorDescription: Edit the Script as plain text. Your changes are saved to the current Draft automatically.
Content.scriptDescription: Plain text only. HTML-like text is kept as text.
Content.scriptHelp: Up to 50,000 characters. Your Draft is saved after you stop typing.
Content.saveFailedDescription: Your complete local text is still here. Try again when you are ready.
Content.conflictDescription: Your complete unsaved text is still here. Reload the authoritative Draft or copy your text before deciding what to keep.
Content.copyFailed: Could not copy the unsaved text. Your text is still here; try copying it again.
Content.reloadFailedTitle: Authoritative Draft could not be loaded
Content.reloadFailedDescription: Your local text is still here. Try reloading again when the server is available.
Content.errorDescription: We could not load this workspace right now. Try again.
Content.notFoundDescription: This Content item is not available in your workspace.

ContentDna.title: Content DNA
ContentDna.description: Capture the context that helps shape your future content.
ContentDna.emptyDescription: Add only the details that are useful for creating your content. Nothing is saved until you choose Save.
ContentDna.editorDescriptionExisting: Update the context that future content work will use. A new immutable version is created only when saved information changes.
ContentDna.statusDescription: This status is calculated from the saved Content DNA.
ContentDna.privacyDescription: Do not include unnecessary credentials or secrets, government identifiers, precise private addresses, or private information about other people.
ContentDna.conflict: A newer Content DNA version was saved elsewhere. Your changes are still here.
ContentDna.reloadErrorTitle: Latest version could not be loaded
ContentDna.reloadError: Your edits are still here. Check your connection and try reloading the latest version again.
ContentDna.validation: Some information could not be saved. Review the fields and try again.
ContentDna.validationDefaultLanguage: Choose a default language that is also selected as a content language.
ContentDna.genericError: We could not save your Content DNA. Please try again.
ContentDna.identityDescription: Describe the perspective, experience, and positioning that make your work recognizably yours.
ContentDna.creatorOrBrandDescriptionHelp: A concise overview is enough for a partial save.
ContentDna.creatorOrBrandDescriptionPlaceholder: What do you create, and what makes your perspective distinct?
ContentDna.audienceDescription: Capture who you want to help, reach, or influence through your content.
ContentDna.targetAudienceDescriptionHelp: Focus on their situation, needs, and level of familiarity.
ContentDna.targetAudienceDescriptionPlaceholder: Who is this content for, and what are they trying to achieve?
ContentDna.expertiseDescription: Prioritize the subjects your content should be known for.
ContentDna.primaryTopicsHelp: Order matters. Put the most important topic first.
ContentDna.voiceDescription: Define the qualities and writing patterns that should remain consistent.
ContentDna.toneTraitsHelp: Order matters. Put the strongest tone trait first.
ContentDna.preferredStyleHelp: Describe recurring stylistic preferences that a short trait cannot capture.
ContentDna.preferredStylePlaceholder: For example: practical explanations, short openings, and concrete examples.
ContentDna.goalsDescription: Prioritize the outcomes your content should work toward.
ContentDna.contentGoalsHelp: Order matters. Put the most important outcome first.
ContentDna.preferencesDescription: Record preferred formats, boundaries, and any guidance that applies across your work.
ContentDna.preferredFormatsHelp: Add the content formats you prefer to create.
ContentDna.topicsToAvoidHelp: Add subjects you do not want your content to cover.
ContentDna.approachesToAvoidHelp: Add styles or approaches that should not be used.
ContentDna.additionalInstructionsHelp: Use this for guidance that does not fit another section.
ContentDna.additionalInstructionsPlaceholder: Add any other durable guidance for your content.
ContentDna.languageDescription: Choose the languages you create in. This is independent from the application interface language.
ContentDna.defaultContentLanguageHelp: The default must also be selected below.
ContentDna.contentLanguagesHelp: Select every language you may use for creator content.
ContentDna.saveBarUnsaved: Your edits are only in this browser until you save.
ContentDna.saveBarClean: Saved changes are recorded as immutable Content DNA versions.
ContentDna.unsavedNavigationDescription: Your changes have not been saved. If you leave this page, they will be lost.
ContentDna.historyPageDescription: Review the exact saved context behind each immutable Content DNA version.
ContentDna.historyDescription: Versions are shown newest first. Each keeps the readiness calculated from its own saved snapshot.
ContentDna.historyEmptyDescription: Your Content DNA history will appear here after you explicitly save it in the editor.

Dashboard.title: Your foundation is ready.
Dashboard.description: Your account and personal workspace are protected and ready for the next step.

Ideas.title: Give your next piece of content a stronger starting point.
Ideas.description: Generate a focused set from your current Content DNA, then decide what deserves a closer look.
Ideas.generationDescription: The current AI-ready version is the only context used for this run. Choose a content language; the count stays fixed at 20.
Ideas.languageHelp: This is the language of generated ideas, not the interface language.
Ideas.noDnaDescription: Ideas are grounded in your creator context. Add the first saved version before generating.
Ideas.incompleteDnaDescription: A few required parts of the current version are missing. Complete Content DNA to unlock generation.
Ideas.historyEmptyDescription: Your completed and failed runs will appear here, newest first.
Ideas.libraryResultsDescription: Ideas match the selected status and generation run.
Ideas.libraryEmptyDescription: Try another status or generation run to review more Ideas.
Ideas.detailEmptyDescription: Choose a run from the history to review its safe result and decision states.
Ideas.activeTitle: Your ideas are on their way
Ideas.pendingDescription: The request is queued for its safe provider invocation. This view will update when it completes.
Ideas.runningDescription: The request is being processed. Keep this page open while the current operation finishes.
Ideas.completedDescription: Review each proposal and make one decision at a time. Your generated text stays unchanged.
Ideas.failureRateLimited: This workspace has reached its generation limit for now. Try again after the limit window passes.
Ideas.failureProviderRateLimited: This generation attempt was recorded as a failed batch because the AI service reached a service limit. Retry when the service is available.
Ideas.failureInvalidOutput: The generated result could not be safely validated. No ideas were added from this run.
Ideas.failureTimeout: The generation took too long to complete. No ideas were added from this run.
Ideas.failureProviderUnavailable: The idea provider was unavailable. No ideas were added from this run.
Ideas.failureInterrupted: The generation was interrupted before it completed. You can retry this run.
Ideas.failureUnknown: The generation could not be completed safely. You can retry this run.
Ideas.rejectDescription: A reason is optional. If you add one, keep it short and useful for your future review.
Ideas.rejectReasonHelp: Up to 500 characters. Your wording is kept as entered.
Ideas.rejectReasonPlaceholder: For example: too close to a recent post…
Ideas.generationSuccess: Generation finished. Your latest batch is ready to review.
Ideas.conflictDescription: The version used by this page is no longer current. Review the latest Content DNA, then try again.
Ideas.rateLimitedDescription: No new batch was created. Wait for the workspace limit window to pass, then try again.
Ideas.providerRateLimitedTitle: The AI service is temporarily limited
Ideas.providerRateLimitedDescription: This generation attempt was recorded as a failed batch. Retry when the AI service is available.
Ideas.providerFailureDescription: The provider did not return a safe result. Review the failed batch below or retry it when ready.
Ideas.invalidOutputTitle: The result was not safe to use
Ideas.invalidOutputDescription: No ideas were added because the generated result did not pass validation. Review the failed batch below.
Ideas.validationDescription: The generation request was not valid. Refresh this page and try again.
Ideas.genericErrorTitle: The request could not be completed
Ideas.genericErrorDescription: Refresh the page and try again. No private provider details are shown here.
Ideas.generateScriptDialogDescription: Choose the content language and format for this synchronous generation request.
Ideas.scriptLanguageHelp: This is the language of the Script, independent of the interface and Idea language.
Ideas.formatHelp: Choose a short or long video Script.
Ideas.instructionsPlaceholder: Add concise guidance for this Script…
Ideas.instructionsHelp: Optional. Up to 1,000 characters. Your wording is kept with this Attempt.
Ideas.contentAttemptPendingDescription: The request is recorded as pending. This history view does not start provider work.
Ideas.contentAttemptRunningDescription: A synchronous provider invocation is recorded as running. This history view does not poll; reopen or refresh later to observe its durable state.
Ideas.contentFailureWorkspaceRateLimited: The workspace quota stopped this request before provider invocation. No provider call was made; try again after the limit window.
Ideas.contentFailureProviderRateLimited: The provider rate-limited this invoked Attempt. The failed Attempt is kept; try again when the service is available.
Ideas.contentFailureInvalidOutput: The invoked result did not pass validation. The failed Attempt is kept; try again when ready.
Ideas.contentFailureTimeout: The invoked request exceeded its allowed time. The failed Attempt is kept; try again when ready.
Ideas.contentFailureProviderUnavailable: The provider was unavailable for this invoked Attempt. The failed Attempt is kept; try again later.
Ideas.contentFailureInterrupted: The invoked request was interrupted before completion. The failed Attempt is kept; try again when ready.
Ideas.contentFailureUnknown: The invoked request did not complete safely. The failed Attempt is kept; try again when ready.
Ideas.contentConflictDescription: This form was opened against an older Content DNA version. Reload the current state before trying again; the request was not sent to the provider.
Ideas.contentWorkspaceRateLimitedDescription: No Attempt was created and no provider call was made. Wait for the workspace limit window to pass, then try again.
Ideas.contentProviderRateLimitedDescription: The provider was invoked and this Attempt was recorded as failed. Try again when the provider is available.
Ideas.contentProviderFailureTitle: Script generation could not be completed
Ideas.contentProviderFailureDescription: The invoked service did not return a safe result. The failed Attempt is kept in history; try again when ready.
Ideas.contentInvalidOutputTitle: The Script result was not safe to use
Ideas.contentInvalidOutputDescription: The invoked result did not pass validation. The failed Attempt is kept in history; try again when ready.
Ideas.contentValidationDescription: The Script request was not valid. Check the three fields and try again.
Ideas.contentGenericErrorTitle: Script generation could not be completed
Ideas.contentGenericErrorDescription: We could not complete this request. Refresh the page and try again; no private provider details are shown.
Ideas.privacyNote: Generated ideas are shown as plain text. Do not include unnecessary sensitive information in Content DNA.
